'''''Ryloth''''' was an advertisement for [[Ryloth/Legends|the planet]] of the same name, featured as a large billboard on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ad featured multiple [[Color/Legends|colors]] and was written in the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet.<ref name="Peace" />
